desc:
🎃 HALLOWEEN UPDATE OUT NOW!

🧪 Welcome to Lethal Ape Experience

You've entered an abandoned facility where experiments went terribly wrong. Monstrous creatures now roam the halls. Stay silent, stay hidden, and survive for as long as you can.

Beware, each monster behaves differently, and every room hides a new threat. Headphones recommended for full effect.
